Fold | Remote (US Only) | Senior Back End Engineer | Full-time

Fold is a publicly listed bitcoin financial services company building the tools people need to earn, buy, sell and live on Bitcoin. We're looking for a Senior BE Engineer to help build the financial infrastructure behind our products - payment processing, ledger systems, card transaction flows and event-driven pipelines.

  - 5+ years software engineering experience
  - Strong in: Java or similar (Kotlin, Scala, C#)
  - Experience with: production microservices, distributed systems
  - Familiar with: messaging/event streaming (Kafka, Pulsar)
  - Solid relational database and data modeling skills
  - Nice-to-have: fintech, payments, ledger/accounting domains
  - Nice-to-have: event-driven architectures, CQRS, event sourcing
  - Nice-to-have: Micronaut, Quarkus or similar modern Java frameworks
  - US residency (regulatory requirement)
Benefits: - Competitive salary + equity - 401k with 3% match - Unlimited PTO + yearly vacation stipend - Full health/dental/vision - Paid parental leave - Regular team meetups - Bitcoin starter pack (hw wallet included)

Email tiffany.sawhney (a) foldapp.com if you have questions or apply here: https://ats.rippling.com/fold-inc/jobs/514ba20e-a93e-4960-ad... [0] https://foldapp.com
